headline: John Cockerill India updates acquisition agreement terms
summary: John Cockerill India Limited has officially revised the terms of its previously announced €24.32 million acquisition. The company disclosed the modification in a regulatory filing. This adjustment alters the conditions under which the transaction will proceed. Retail investors should note that changes to acquisition terms can impact the company's cash flow and future earnings projections.
why_it_matters: Acquisition cost changes may impact company balance sheet and valuation.
